title: LIC HFL Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 232 Apprentice Posts
description: The LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL) has officially released the notification to fill the vacancies of 232 Apprentice Posts. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for these posts before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed any degree can apply for the LIC HFL Notification 2026. The interested applicants can apply in online mode.
